name: How long does custom framing take for a new home?

mainEntity.name: How long does custom framing take for a new home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of custom framing depends on the size and complexity of the home's design. A typical single-family home in Pasadena might take anywhere from 4 to 12 weeks for the framing stage. Factors such as the number of stories, intricate roof lines, unique wall angles, and weather conditions can extend this timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after initial design finalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom framing for a new home typically takes 4 to 12 weeks, depending on the size, complexity, and specific design elements.
